fields.description: Save pages, selections and links to the Blurby account from Chrome and Firefox (owner design 2026-11-03): sign in from the extension; a pop-up on selected text prompts to save, and right-click saving stays; a Saved to your library notice opens the item in Blurby; desktop pairing stays as the fallback. Firefox port; listed on the Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons. Saved articles land in Newsroom (APP-TABS-1). Supersedes the deferred Track B lane (EXT-ENR-C and beyond); reading inside the browser is out of scope.
